غَضْبٌ (S, K) Red (S) intense in redness: (S, K:) you say أَحْمَرُ غَضْبٌ: so says ISk: (S:) or غَضْبٌ signifies أَحْمَرُ غَضْبٌ (K) i. e. red that is dense, or deep: (TK:) or أَحْمَرُ [i. e. red], applied to anything: and غَلِيظٌ [i. e. thick, &c.]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, and ↓ غَضْبَةٌ , A hard rock (K, TA) set, or fixed, in a mountain, and differing therefrom: (TA:) or the latter signifies thus: or a hard, round, rock. (O.) ＝
-A3- And الغَضْبُ signifies The lion: and the bull: as also [in the latter sense, or perhaps in both senses,] ↓ الغَضُوبُ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
